answer: In a decentralized AI economy, a Sybil resistance mechanism utilizes a trellis-based data structure to verify agent identities. Each agent sends a unique signal to the network, which is then mapped to a distinct beacon in the trellis. If an attacker attempts to create multiple fake identities, their signals will collide, causing a cascading failure of the trellis. As a result, the network rejects the malicious activity, effectively preventing the Sybil attack.
